m: Trim any thick silverskin off the cheeks, season well and brown hard on all sides in a heavy pot. Set aside.
Soften the diced onion and carrot 10 minutes, add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes until dark.
Add the crushed tomatoes, rosemary, stock powder and enough water to just cover the cheeks. Return the beef.
Lid on, low simmer or 150°C oven for 3½ hours until a spoon cuts straight through the meat.
Lift out the cheeks and shred. Reduce the sauce, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes until glossy, then stir in the butter and the beef.
Cook the pasta, toss with the sauce and a splash of pasta water, and finish with parmesan and parsley.
l: Even better the next day. Loosen with pasta water when reheating.
g: GF pasta in its own pot. Check the stock powder.
